'''Kilaphor Dashta''' was a famous [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] who made a map of the [[Dashta Mountains]] and the [[Zantay Caves]], the first time he arrived at [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] around 422 BBY.
